_comment: Pilot 2 (GPU): extend B's food_sense ladder upward. B's pilot (eb36b7a) found that 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10 change foraging in 0 of 3 species by the pre-registered rule and chose 10 by fallback. Same rule, 64 seeds per gain instead of 1, gains 30/100/300/1000, kappa 3, treat arm, food on, 10,000 steps. Reference food_sense = 0 comes from the smoke_b64 output (OSCILLIS) plus the fs0 cells of the running 2x2 (all species, seeds 1-50, read at step 10,000).
